findings.title: "Plugin Request Completed" log loses its traceID field
findings.body: The old logRequest explicitly appended "traceID" (from tracing.TraceIDFromContext) to logParams. The new code replaces m.logger.Info with m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info and drops that append, while instrumentContext in contextual_logger_middleware.go only sets endpoint, pluginId, dsName, dsUID and uname in the contextual attributes. Unless the underlying infra logger independently injects a traceID at log time, the completed-request log no longer carries traceID, breaking correlation between this log line and traces/other traceID-tagged logs.

findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards the logger's recorded state
findings.body: FromContext returns NewTestLogger(), a fresh instance, instead of returning the receiver (or a logger sharing its Logs). LoggerMiddleware now logs via m.logger.FromContext(ctx).Info(...), so any test that constructs a TestLogger, passes it to the middleware, and then asserts on that instance's InfoLogs.Calls/Message/Ctx will observe zero calls because the log was recorded on the throwaway instance. The fake should return f (sharing state) so existing and future LoggerMiddleware tests can assert on the log output.

findings.title: New ContextualLoggerMiddleware has no test coverage and the logger/context contract is untested
findings.body: This PR adds ContextualLoggerMiddleware, moves instrumentContext into it, makes LoggerMiddleware depend on FromContext(ctx) picking up endpoint/pluginId/dsName/dsUID/uname from the context, and depends on middleware ordering in CreateMiddlewares for that to work. No test is added for the new middleware, and the renamed metrics_middleware_test.go only covers metrics. A regression in ordering or in instrumentContext (e.g. LoggerMiddleware running before the context is enriched) would silently drop all of those fields from "Plugin Request Completed" logs with no failing test.
